# Wowlife Silver Tone Floral Fingertip Nail Sharp Claw Jewelry Finger Claws

## Add a Striking Finishing Touch to Any Costume

Make your next costume unforgettable with these silver-tone floral finger claws. Each set includes five rings with sharp, claw-style tips that add drama to Halloween, cosplay, and belly dance looks.

## Features Built for Costume Play

These unisex rings are crafted from sturdy metal with an intricate floral design. Each ring measures 8 cm and can be adjusted to help you find a comfortable fit. The set comes with five rings, so you can wear them across multiple fingers.

## Benefits That Elevate Your Look

Sturdy metal construction helps the rings hold their shape through long events, so you can focus on the fun. The silver-tone finish complements a range of outfits, from gothic and fantasy themes to Egyptian and gypsy styles. Their bold design also makes them a playful gift for cosplayers, Halloween fans, and anyone who loves statement accessories.
